name: Call Personal
overview: Scripture reveals that God's call is universal and persistent, echoing continuously like the speech of day and night that cannot be silenced (Psalms 19:2-3). Wisdom personified calls out openly to all people, inviting them at the city gates to respond (Proverbs 8:3-4). Yet, the call is contrasted with the hypocrisy of some who impose heavy burdens without help, emphasizing that true obedience to God's call involves sincere action rather than mere words (Matthew 23:3-4). This highlights the personal and effectual nature of God's invitation, urging individuals to heed His voice and live accordingly.
